name: hooks-worktrunk
description: Enforces Worktrunk as the worktree-management interface for Claude and Codex. A cross-runtime PreToolUse guard denies direct git worktree and gh pr checkout commands with the equivalent wt command. Native task agents claim their bead in the parent checkout, create linked worktrees through wt, record the returned branch and absolute path, and work from that path. Claude-only WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove handlers route the native lifecycle through wt. A SessionStart sweep reports abandoned Worktrunk worktrees and reclaims their git-ignored build output; it never removes a worktree or branch, leaving that to `wt remove`, which already refuses an unmerged branch. Steering and config templates cover official plugins, agent checkout lifecycle, hook ownership, repository-scoped build targets, copy-ignored warm starts, deterministic dev-server ports, aliases, and LLM commit generation.
